scope: Vertical aqueous electronic-plus-solvent coupling; not Gibbs free energies, macroscopic pKas or a production correction.
paired_difference_scope: Raw aqueous electronic differences after removing two H+ nuclei; proton reservoir omitted. Neither difference is a deprotonation Gibbs energy.
component_scope: Bookkeeping in separately polarized aqueous SCF densities; not independent gas/solvent free-energy components.
limitations: Vertical electronic-plus-solvent coupling only; no new nuclear optimization, RRHO or conformer ensembles.
A nonzero vertical coupling does not measure a macroscopic pKa or establish the full free-energy correction.
These two charged states do not establish complete physiological protonation/Mg speciation.
No production potential or experimental accuracy is selected from this control.
An atom-balanced exchange can have nonzero energy; this is not a cycle-closure failure.
